caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display across a calm, dark body of water. Near the horizon, a smaller ground burst sits left and a larger red dome-shaped burst sits right, while a broad cluster of high blue-white sparkles hangs above. The high sparkles are brightest early in the visible display and gradually thin into faint scattered dots. The right ground burst changes in place: its red outline remains while a bright white core ignites, white streaks spread outward, and a purple-blue center emerges. The left ground burst also stays fixed but gains a brighter white core and mixed purple-blue tints. Vertical reflections mirror these color shifts, turning from red-white streaks into red, white, and purple-blue columns. A fixed city-light strip with a thin vertical beam lines the left horizon, and a dark silhouette occupies the right edge.
